The '''''Krakana''''' was a [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] that was used by the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the ''Krakana'' was ordered to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], where the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] intended to use it as an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] battery. However, the vessel was destroyed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] while en-route to Kuat.
